$comment: Root ADR-0144 §4, ADR-0145. VWorld 필지고유번호변동연혁 (MK/30527): the official old PNU -> new PNU record, the third step of 법정동 code pairing. How its files are chosen, what each must look like, and how a row is read. The collection script (scripts/ops/parcel-number-change-collect.sh), the parser and loader (infra/lakehouse/spark/jobs/vworld_parcel_number_change_history.py), the pairing (legal_dong_code_change_pairs.py) and the tests read this file; nothing else restates these values. Measured 2026-10-05 on two province files (인천, 경기) and the provider's table definition (ABPD_UNQ_NO_CHG_HIST.xlsx).

bronze_objects.$comment: Root ADR-0152. The provider uploads a changed file under the same file number, and the Bronze bucket refuses to overwrite a key, so every object is named by its file and its bytes: <download_ds_id>-<file_no>--sha256-<checksum>.<ext>, the form the 연속지적도 objects of 2026-09 carry. The collection script asks the ingest for it (FOUNDATION_PLATFORM_VWORLD_DATASET_FILE_BRONZE_KEY=content_addressed); a rerun of the same bytes finds its own object and writes nothing. stage-handoff and load refuse any other key and any bytes whose SHA-256 is not the one the key names. superseded_plain_keys: the first production run (2026-10-05) wrote all 20 files under plain keys and then stopped before staging, so no handoff, accepted state or Silver row names them. They stay (append-only; the bucket's object lock keeps them) and nothing reads them; their ledger rows are repointed to the content keys when the same bytes are collected again, which leaves a displaced-key event that the R2 inventory audit lists as a delete candidate. Do not delete them.

expected_listing.$comment: What the provider's page listed on 2026-10-05: 19 province zips and the table definition. The plan carries it into the inventory as the expected count; a different count is a warning there, not a refusal, because the provider's page decides.

files.$comment: One zip per 시도, replaced in place when the provider's 지적 records change (file numbers are reused; the provider's 갱신일 and size tell a new upload apart). Every file the listing names is collected into Bronze, each upload its own object: the 시도 zips (including the old-name files the provider kept beside the renamed 시도, 강원 and 전북 before 특별자치도, and 전남/광주 before their merger) are loaded; the table definition (xlsx) is kept as evidence of the layout and not loaded. A listed file matching neither pattern refuses the run. The pairing reads links by content, so a row an old-name file repeats counts once.

pnu_parts.$comment: A PNU is 시군구(5) + 읍면동리(5) + 대장구분(1) + 본번(4) + 부번(4) = 19 digits. A row whose 대장구분 is 0 and 본번·부번 0000 moves a whole 법정동 (the provider writes a renumbered 동 as one such row, not one per parcel).

quarantine.$comment: Measured 2026-10-05 over all 19 시도 files: some rows carry a blank or non-date LAND_MOV_YMD (text in the date column, reasons 43/81), and one 서울 row of 41,450 has 3-digit 본번·부번. Per file the share is 0 to 1.46e-3 (경북 42 of 28,733; 충북 14 of 39,972; 경기 14 of 356,046). Such a row is kept with quarantine_reason set (unparseable_land_mov_ymd, malformed_pnu), never dropped and never used as evidence. A file with more than max_share (about three times the measured maximum) and more than max_rows_any_file quarantined rows is refused whole: then the layout moved, not a few rows. The row allowance keeps a few bad rows from refusing a small 시도's file (제주 is about 3 KiB). A date later than the day after the collection is quarantined too (implausible_land_mov_ymd): the provider cannot have recorded a change that has not happened.

bounds.$comment: A province file below min_rows_per_file is refused (제주 is the smallest real file: about 3 KiB). The history only grows; a file with fewer rows than the one it replaces by more than max_shrink_share is refused.
